title: A 90s Village Love Story 🚲🌧️ pure nostalgia #shorts

segments.moment_description: The couple riding a bicycle together along the riverside
Walking side by side with the bicycle, talking and smiling
A playful moment at the village hand pump, splashing water
A quiet tender moment sitting together by the pond
Sheltering close together from the sudden monsoon rain - the romantic peak

description:
A little love story from 1990s village India 🚲🌧️ — a bicycle ride by the river, a quiet moment by the pond, and shelter from the first monsoon rain. Simpler times, simpler love.

Does this take you back? 👇 Tell me your favourite 90s memory.

A slow, warm slice of nostalgia — the way romance felt before phones.
